rules.title: Seed everything
rules.text: Set seeds for Python, NumPy and PyTorch and log them with each run.

rules.title: Device-agnostic code
rules.text: Write device-agnostic code and move tensors and models explicitly.

rules.title: eval and no_grad
rules.text: Call model.eval() and use torch.no_grad() or inference_mode for inference.

rules.title: Config-driven experiments
rules.text: Drive experiments from config files and track metrics and artifacts in an experiment tracker.

rules.title: No data leakage
rules.text: Split data before any preprocessing fit and never tune on the test set.
